regions.region: title, abstract, introduction, and Results and Discussion opening
regions.finding: True title and DOI confirmed; prose introduces the present iron-catalyzed arylallene polymerization. Prior-work narrative was treated as context, not as this paper's experiments.
Two cited literature polymerization arrows (Endo nickel and Cui rare-earth systems) recorded as literature_example summaries, not present-paper experiments.
This-work generic arylallene polymerization arrow recorded as generic_scheme; individual experiments are represented by later table rows.

unresolved: Scheme 1 literature panels summarize cited papers and do not supply complete procedures or all monomer identities.

regions.finding: All seven hydride-source rows were enumerated. Entry 4 is the same standard-condition experiment repeated as Table 2 entry 1 and was merged rather than duplicated. Entry 2 includes a distinct 7% hydroborated side-product result; entry 7 is a no-[Fe] zero-conversion control.
NMR conformer discussion and four DFT conformers are analytical/computational context, not additional synthesis experiments; retained in source_context.

unresolved: The main-text table does not show the identity/regiochemistry of the 7% hydroborated product.
Polymer tacticity, chain-end distribution, and residual-alkene geometry are not fully specified; polymer identities remain generic templates.

regions.finding: All seven condition rows were checked. Row 1 is the Table 1 entry 4 repeat. Rows 2-7 are separate records. Entry 4 has an unresolved source-internal Mn conflict: table cell 12.6 kDa versus footnote [a] >250 kDa. Entry 5 separately retains 90% polymer and 6% dimer with measurement basis unresolved.
Repeat mass/end-group observations and amorphous-material characterization were retained as source_context, not synthesis records.
Cyclohexylallene and methoxyallene no-polymerization observations were recorded as separate true controls without invented products or silently inherited charges.

Kinetic-order, PMe3 poisoning, radical-clock, labelled-monomer, two deuterated-hydride, iron-hydride-dimer, and H2-control experiments were separated. Scheme 2 isotope observations were not converted into unsupported yields.

unresolved: No SI was supplied, so kinetic datasets, radical-clock identity, poisoning loadings, and Scheme 2b quench details remain unavailable.
Table 2 entry 4 Mn conflict cannot be resolved from the main text.
The 90% polymer/6% dimer split in Table 2 footnote [b] lacks a separately stated measurement basis.

regions.region: Table 3 reaction scheme, legend, rows 1-6, and footnotes
regions.finding: All six substrate-scope rows were extracted separately. The legend establishes 2=p-Me, 3=m-Me, 4=o-Me, 5=p-OMe, 6=p-F, 7=p-Cl. Entries 5 and 6 use 5 mol% [Fe]; all other common conditions were retained.
The page-4 prose supplies the 5% conversion and absence of H3N·BH3 for the ([Fe]H)2 record, merged with the page-3 scheme evidence.
Catalyst activation and intermediates I-III were recorded as a proposed_mechanism, not as experimentally confirmed isolated reactions.

unresolved: Polymer stereoregularity and residual C=C geometry are not assigned in Table 3; products remain partial generic templates.
Scheme 3 is explicitly postulated and does not establish elementary-step yields or isolated intermediates.

regions.region: continuation of Scheme 3 discussion and Fe(I)-η6-arene experiment
regions.finding: The proposed propagation discussion remains part of the mechanism record. The separate Fe(I)-arene catalyst experiment (90% conversion, 6:1 regioisomer ratio, Mn 190 kDa, Đ 1.51, no hydride) is a concrete mechanistic-study record.

The phenylallene [2+2] cycloaddition was recorded with 5 mol% [Fe], 10 mol% H3N·BH3, C6D6, 80 °C, 16 h, 27% isolated combined yield, and 2:1 cis:trans. Cis and trans products are separate template identities; exocyclic Z/E remains unassigned.

The 670 μL feed/6 mL receiving benzene volumes, 20 μL min−1 addition rate, 5 mol% H3N·BH3, and 1 mol% [Fe] were structured; no substantial yield increase and continued polymer dominance were preserved qualitatively.
Me2DN·BH3 and Me2HN·BD3 variants were represented as two isotope experiments, each reporting no 2H incorporation and retaining unstated loadings/conditions as unresolved.
No additional present-paper reaction arrow or table row was found; referenced prior work was not recast as new experiments.

unresolved: Fe(I)-arene catalyst loading and reaction conditions are not restated.
Scheme 4 omits phenylallene charge and C6D6 volume.
Dilute-addition and deuterated cycloaddition experiments omit several quantities and measurement details in the main text.

regions.finding: Page visually contains bibliography and received/accepted/version dates only; no present-paper reaction arrow, table, footnote, or new experimental result was found.
